quote: CHALLENGER LINK BROKEN -- [L1] Matthew 1:18 "before they came together, she was found with child of the Holy Ghost" and Matthew 1:25 "knew her not till she had brought forth her firstborn son" contradict C3's claim of espousal union; [L2] πρὶν ἢ συνελθεῖν (prin ē synelthein, Strong's G4250/G4905, before coming together) and οὐκ ἐγίνωσκεν (ouk eginōsken, Strong's G1097, was not knowing); [L3] Luke 1:34.
why: The link is declared broken by counting these cited verses, yet the judge names no round and quotes no sentence of an earlier round pressing them against the link, and Luke 1:34 is listed as a ground though merely cited and never pressed, which the rule says does not count.
